# ToolNest

> 1,000+ fast, free, privacy-first browser-based online tools for students, software engineers, career professionals, and everyday tasks. 100% client-side processing with zero server tracking or login requirements.

ToolNest is an engineering suite developed by Md Jalaluddin Master (Ammar Master) and ProDevOpz (https://prodevopz.jobsio.in). All utilities run directly inside client web browsers using modern web standards (WebAssembly, Canvas, Web Crypto, and TypeScript) without transmitting user files or computations to any external server.

## Curated SEO Hubs & Search Engine

- [Search 1,000+ Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/search): Live searchable directory with keyword tokens and category filters.
- [Free PDF Tools Suite](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/free-pdf-tools): Full client-side PDF & Image suite: Compress PDF, Protect with Password, Watermark, Sign, Page Numbers, PDF to Word DOCX, Merge, Split, Rotate, Image Resizer, and WebP/PNG/JPG converters.
- [Student Calculators](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/student-calculators): CGPA to percentage, SGPA, attendance requirement, and Pomodoro study timer.
- [Developer Utilities](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/developer-utilities): JSON formatter, Base64 encoder/decoder, SQL beautifier, and hash tools.
- [Finance & Salary Calculators](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/finance-calculators): In-hand salary, home loan EMI, GST tax breakdown, and compound interest.
- [Universal Unit Converters](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/unit-converters): Bidirectional conversion for length, mass, temperature, speed, and bytes.

## Tool Categories

- [Student Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/student): Academic calculators including Cumulative CGPA, Semester GPA, Attendance tracker, Grade estimator, Percentage converter, and Pomodoro focus timer.
- [Career & Job Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/career): Career planning utilities including CTC to In-Hand Salary breakdown, Salary Hike calculator, Notice Period planner, and Resume ATS Keyword Checker.
- [Developer Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/developer): Software engineering utilities including JSON Formatter & Validator, Base64 Encoder/Decoder, URL Encoder, Hash Generators (SHA-256, MD5, SHA-512), UUID/GUID Generator, and SQL Formatter.
- [PDF & Document Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf): Full privacy-first iLovePDF alternative suite: Compress PDF by 80%, Protect PDF with password, Watermark PDF, Add Page Numbers, Sign PDF online, Convert PDF to Word (DOCX), Merge PDF, Split PDF, Rotate PDF, Image Resizer, PNG to JPG, JPG to PNG, and WebP converter.
- [Text & Writing Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/text): Real-time Word Counter, Character Counter, Case Converter, Slug Generator, Duplicate Line Remover, and Text Difference Checker.
- [Math & Calculators](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/math): Scientific Calculator, Percentage Calculator, Fraction Simplifier, LCM/GCD Finder, Statistics Engine, and Probability Solver.
- [Date & Time Tools](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/date): High-precision Age Calculator, Date Difference Finder, Days Between Dates, Countdown Timer, and Stopwatch.
- [Unit Converters](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/converter): High-precision conversions for Length, Weight/Mass, Temperature, Volume, Digital Data Storage, Speed, Area, and Time.
- [Finance & Business](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/finance): Loan EMI Calculator, Compound Interest Calculator, Simple Interest, GST/Sales Tax Calculator, SIP Calculator, and Profit Margin Calculator.

## Most Popular Tools

- [Compress PDF](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/compress-pdf): Compress and reduce PDF file size by up to 80% with zero quality loss 100% in-browser.
- [PDF to Word Converter](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/pdf-to-docx): Convert PDF files to editable DOCX documents directly in the browser with zero server upload.
- [Sign PDF Online](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/sign-pdf): Draw digital signature using touchscreen or mouse and stamp directly into PDF pages.
- [Protect PDF](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/protect-pdf): Encrypt and lock PDF documents with secure password protection client-side.
- [Watermark PDF](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/watermark-pdf): Add custom text watermarks (e.g. Confidential, Draft) with adjustable opacity and rotation.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/image-resizer): Resize JPG, PNG, and WebP images by exact pixel dimensions or percentage scaling with aspect ratio lock.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/student/cgpa-calculator): Calculate Cumulative Grade Point Average across all semesters with weighted credits and percentage conversion.
- [CTC to In-Hand Salary Calculator](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/career/ctc-to-inhand-calculator): Calculate take-home monthly salary from annual CTC with tax and PF deductions.
- [JSON Formatter](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/developer/json-formatter): Format, validate, inspect, and minify JSON data client-side.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/pdf/qr-code-generator): Generate downloadable high-resolution QR codes for URLs, text, and Wi-Fi networks.
- [Age Calculator](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/date/age-calculator): Calculate precise age in years, months, weeks, days, hours, and minutes.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://toolnest.jobsio.in/finance/loan-emi-calculator): Compute monthly home, car, or personal loan EMIs with total interest and amortization table.

## Architecture & Privacy Guarantee

- **Client-Side Execution:** All file conversions (PDF, Images), cryptographic operations (SHA, MD5), and mathematical calculations execute within the user's browser runtime.
- **Zero Data Retention:** No documents, passwords, or personal parameters are ever logged or uploaded to remote servers.
- **No Authentication Required:** Instant access to all 1,000+ tools without registration, accounts, or rate limits.
